data.current_description:
Opening and closing line per (book, market, outcome).

Closing = the last snapshot at or before commence_time — the canonical line CLV-tracking tools measure against. Opening = the first snapshot we hold for the outcome, however far before kickoff the book posted it (use `opening_window` to limit the lookback).
